name: bld3_mantel_equality_colorable_two
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) : G.Colorable 2
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2), G.Colorable 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_mantel_equality_regular and Mathlib2.bld_mantel_triangle_free: if there is no edge then n = 0; otherwise fix an edge u v: N(u) and N(v) are disjoint with |N(u)| + |N(v)| = n by regularity, so they partition V, and each is independent by triangle-freeness; colour by membership in N(u).
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2 → G.Colorable 2
